How shall we take this corner? Let us count the ways. With the MDX, you can choose three
distinct styles of driving: Comfort, Normal, and Sport. The different settings affect the feel
of the steering and the acceleration. Even the sound of the engine changes to get you in
the mood. For instance: on a long, pleasant cruise? Comfort. Commuting to work? Normal.
And as for sport mode? That’s entirely up to you. 5
